verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own no-code automations, workflows built with Wrike agents that 'handle your everyday tasks,' and natural-language automation rule generation, so the core workflow-automation capability exists. Nothing in the evidence shows time-based schedules or recurring triggers, so the defining element of this story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/cron-style or recurring triggers, documented event-trigger configuration, engineer-facing setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Connect Wrike to your apps, build no-code automations, and run end-to-end workflows from one secure platform.
Build workflows with Wrike agents and let them handle your everyday tasks.
